item.tib: shes rab byams ma kun gsal rgyas pa'i mngon rtogs thar lam gsal byed
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni gshen gyi klog pa g.yung drung tshul khrims kyis kun gsal rgyas pa las bsdus te/ bkra shis sman ri'i khrod du sbyar ba'i/ mkha' yang kun gsal klong gis (gi) skyed mo tshal/ rab mdzes dkyil 'khor bkod pa bsam mtha' yas/ mchog tu bsags pa'i nye lam zab mo'i don/ gsal byed 'di yang kun la 'phel 'gyur cig/
